about: Which money actions need the MPIN, a verified ID (kyc) and the untrusted-device cap (deviceCap: money out, so a phone that isn't trusted yet moves only up to the cap), and which are money in from the linked bank (moneyIn: the ID gate, never the MPIN). One entry per action; the server's suite also fails when its table gains an action that has no entry here. On the phone the Practice simulator is held to it by behaviour: each action is called without the MPIN, with the ID unverified, and over the cap on a new phone, and must answer mpin_required, kyc_required and device_untrusted exactly when this table says so.
phone: mobile/src/lib/api/demo/* (each Practice money move: requirePracticeMpin, assertPracticeIdVerified, assertPracticeDeviceCap)

actions.why: a proof-checked withdrawal from a vault
wallet to a vault: stays inside the account, so no device cap
raising or turning off the wallet's daily limit
any withdrawal or emergency limit going up
a one-off Core buy from the bank
setting up a Core plan, or one that moves more money
every Satellite allocation from the bank
changing the MPIN needs the current one
trusting a phone (with a texted code)
adding or replacing the verified phone number
bank to a vault (a deposit, or a new vault's first deposit): money in
practice salary and card events on the linked bank: money in
round-ups from the bank to a vault: money in
